calendar_assumption: Forty fictional comparable weekdays, including holidays; not a real Cornell operating calendar.
limitations: Finite intentionally constructed teaching examples; zero normal alerts is not a general probability claim.
No real demand, calibrated routing, hills, causal claims or dispatcher intervention is modeled.
CSV snapshots do not reveal attempted rentals, failed trips or exact downtime.
The generator validates using app/qc.py but does not implement a second detector or approve any baseline.
Pattern selection uses complete synthetic candidate schedules offline; application scoring remains causal and uses no future observations.

model.capacity_handling: No departure from an empty station; every arrival checks capacity and reroutes with added positive riding time if full
model.corridor_limitation: Ten independent illustrative rider corridors; deliberately restricted OD patterns, not citywide routing or measured demand
model.initial_allocation: 15 bikes per station at the first 07:00 only; no later reset, operator dispatch or nighttime rebalancing
model.initial_bike_ids: B001-B015 at S01, then successive blocks of fifteen through B286-B300 at S20
model.itinerary_construction: Seeded finite hourly rider schedules, accepted using the unchanged app detector; actual individual departures and arrivals realize every snapshot, never CSV clipping or stock assignment
model.late_rides: Some riders depart before an hourly reading and return 120–180 seconds after it; they are included in the in-transit fleet at that reading
model.normal_profile: Main campus home-side designed full-stock profile08:00–21:00 (07:00 entry ignored; inherited from overnight rides) before late departures: [17, 14, 11, 10, 11, 12, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15, 16, 17, 17, 17]; seeded day offsets and hourly jitter; no-alert fixture selection is explicitly intentional
model.off_hours: Sparse independently seeded overnight/weekend riders evolve forward from actual settled stocks; 07:00 inherits their result, never a preselected morning target or stock15 reset
model.sensors: Accurate complete automatic readings; no missingness or sensor-failure simulation
model.shared_history: Same rider events and pending trips through first monitoring day07:00; changed schedules begin afterward

provenance: Entirely designed synthetic rider itineraries at real geographic landmark anchors; no observed customer demand or sensor records.
